markScheme.observation: Publisher metadata: paper log P75826A and publication code 4PH1_1P_2406_MS match paper.
General guidance: positive marking, full range available, scheme precedence and crossed-out response replacement rule; no per-leaf AO allocation.
Q1 four leaves/5 marks. Diagram and orbit-comparison alternatives; force-name and orbit-object exclusions.
Q2 five leaves/5 marks; answer letters A,B,D,A,C with rationales.

Q3 five leaves/10 marks. Similarities capped at two; reverse comparisons accepted; POT penalty. Decimal alternative appears inconsistent with 5e-9 s. Q3(d) combined absorption/energy statement may earn both.
Q4 three leaves/9 marks. One tick per energy-store row; any four comparison points, reverse arguments accepted.
Q5 four leaves/11 marks. Length-axis alternative, ECF from resultant force and linked acceleration reasoning.
Q6 five leaves/8 marks. Two inward arrows; spaced-field single phrase can earn both; induced north pole and soft magnetic behavior.
Q7 six leaves/12 marks. Power alternatives and ECF energy; one mark for an attempted sum even with wrong selected branches.
Q8 one leaf/6 marks; any six of seven points, ray-angle tolerances and ECF; erroneous optical-density concession separately flagged.
Q9 three leaves/6 marks. Any two collapse explanations, any three molecular-pressure points.
Q10(a,b.i,b.ii,b.iii): four leaves/8 marks. Mass-unit penalty and g alternatives; control and measurement criteria.
Q10(c.i-c.iv): four leaves/7 marks; scaled height 30-32 cm; graph scale/plot/curve criteria, ECF and zero-mark proportionality contradiction rule.
Q11 four leaves/11 marks; independent ECF unit conversion; cable-current/time combined point; capacity evaluation with realistic alternatives.
Q12 three leaves/12 marks. Nested graph-reading total-score bands and terminal-motion reasoning.
Publisher footer only; no assessed task.

sourceDiscrepancies.observation: Scheme gives 5.0 × 10^-9 s but also permits decimal 0.00000005 s (=5 × 10^-8 s). Independent 1.5/(3.0e8)=5e-9 s. Correct decimal is 0.000000005 s.
sourceDiscrepancies.handling: Preserve the published discrepancy for review. Generated solutions must use the verified arithmetic; do not teach the inconsistent decimal.

sourceDiscrepancies.observation: MP5 allows different optical densities; its note condones air having higher optical density than water, while MP6/7 correctly state slower travel in water and denser water.
sourceDiscrepancies.handling: Preserve as a historical marking concession; never promote reversed optical density to correct physics in a template.
